Title: AI Engineer
Location: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Johnson Controls International (JCI) is seeking an AI Engineer to join our innovative and impact-driven Data Science and Analytics team. This role is ideal for an engineer who combines solid software, data, and ML engineering skills with hands-on Generative AI experience—and a data scientist's curiosity for how models behave. You build the pipelines, tooling, and applications that turn AI and LLM models into dependable production software. As an AI Engineer, you will independently own the end-to-end delivery of defined AI projects—from data pipeline through deployed application. You will make sound technical decisions within your scope, partner directly with cross-functional stakeholders, and guide junior engineers on specific problems as you deliver measurable business value. How You Will Do It Generative AI Systems & Applications Develop and deploy Generative AI systems and LLM-powered applications (e.g., GPT, Claude, LLaMA) for use cases such as enterprise search, document summarization, and conversational AI. Apply prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and orchestration techniques to adapt foundation models for domain-specific applications. Build agentic workflows and task-specific AI agents—using Palantir AIP or the Microsoft Agent Framework—that orchestrate tools, retrieval, and reasoning. Evaluate and improve model outputs for accuracy, relevance, latency, and cost, applying data science techniques to measure and validate performance. Data, ML & Software Engineering Build and maintain the data pipelines that feed AI systems—ingestion, transformation, and ETL across structured and unstructured sources (e.g., Snowflake, Azure). Develop and operate ML pipelines and MLOps workflows—training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring—using CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and model serving. Build reusable components, services, and APIs around AI models that help the team ship features faster. Implement retrieval and embedding workflows (RAG, vector databases) for scalable, accurate knowledge retrieval. Apply software engineering best practices—testing, version control, and code review—across your projects. Business Impact & Stakeholder Communication Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business challenges into AI solutions. Support workshops and proofs-of-concept that demonstrate the value of LLM and agent use cases across business units. Translate model outputs, data findings, and technical tradeoffs into clear insights for non-technical audiences. Mentorship & Collaboration Guide junior engineers on specific technical problems and code quality. Contribute to design discussions and technical decisions within the team. Share knowledge and help raise the bar on engineering and data science practices. Qualifications & Experience Education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical or quantitative discipline. 2–5 years of experience in software, data, ML engineering, or data science, including hands-on work with LLMs or generative AI. Demonstrated success delivering data or ML pipelines and AI/ML solutions to production. Experience with data science fundamentals—exploratory analysis, statistical modeling, or classic ML (classification, regression, forecasting). Experience with cloud AI platforms such as Azure OpenAI/Azure ML, AWS SageMaker/Bedrock, or Google Cloud Vertex AI. Technical Expertise Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with good software engineering habits—testing, version control, and clean code. Hands-on experience with the Generative AI stack: prompt engineering, fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA), LLM orchestration, and agent frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework). Experience building ETL and ML pipelines and applying MLOps practices (CI/CD, Docker, model serving). Familiarity with data science libraries and workflows—pandas, scikit-learn, and model evaluation and experimentation. Experience with JCI's stack—or comparable platforms—including Palantir AIP, Azure ML, Microsoft Agent Framework, Power Automate, and Snowflake. Working knowledge of embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval systems. Soft Skills Ability to own projects and communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly. Strong collaboration skills across product, engineering, and business teams. Comfortable presenting technical and analytical work to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Self-directed problem solver who manages priorities independently. Preferred Qualifications Experience with IoT, edge analytics, or smart building systems. Familiarity with LLMOps, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration frameworks. Data science depth—statistical modeling, experimentation, or deep learning (forecasting, computer vision, or NLP). Experience with the Microsoft ecosystem (Microsoft 365 Copilot, SharePoint, Power Platform, Snowflake). Knowledge of data privacy and governance considerations for enterprise LLM usage. Title: (CEN) SR PROCESS SPECIALIST
Location: Villa de García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Job Description Make SmartOps optimization and anomaly detection models work in CEMEX cement plants, and keep them working. As the production and quality expert of the SmartOps program, specify and validate models with data scientists, confirm plant readiness, commission solutions on site, and coach plant teams until gains in yield, heat and power consumption, quality stability, and safety are verified against baseline. Build the repeatable method that lets each new plant start from what worked at the last one. Main Responsibilities CEMEX Values & Leadership: Work following the Mission, Vision, and Values of CEMEX, leading by example across all corporate and plant-level interactions. Process models Model specification: Work with data scientists and control specialists to define each model's variables, time delays, constraints, and valid operating ranges for raw mix, grinding, kiln, and cement quality. Set quality targets from LSF, moduli, free lime, fineness, and strength, and ground the logic in process chemistry and heat and mass balances. Anomaly detection: Design detection rules and models for abnormal process behavior, false air, refractory condition, and quality drift. Validate them against real events, measure false alerts, missed events, and warning time, and assign a response owner to each alert. Work with maintenance and reliability specialists where process and equipment anomalies overlap, such as mill overload. Validation and lifecycle: Test models on historical data and plant trials against agreed acceptance criteria before release. Afterward, track performance, use root cause analysis (RCA) on gaps and operator overrides, and update logic when raw materials, fuels, products, or equipment change. Keep approved versions on record, with agreed fallback and retuning rules. Remote monitoring and advisory: When not on site, review model alerts, autopilot utilization, and operator overrides across plants from Monterrey. Send recommendations to plant teams and escalate when they are not acted on. Plant readiness Minimum requirements and audits: Define the minimum instrumentation, automation, and data each SmartOps use case needs, from sensor accuracy and calibration to historian sampling and lab data. Before commissioning, audit the plant with site instrumentation and automation teams, check signals, tag mapping, and data availability, and support PID loop tuning and alarm optimization. Send validated changes to the owner of the CEMEX instrumentation catalog. Gap analysis and business cases: Rank gaps in sensors, actuators, analyzers, and data quality against SmartOps requirements. Build CAPEX or OPEX business cases with site teams and follow execution through field verification and acceptance. Deployment and adoption Hands-on implementation: Work beside operators, engineers, and maintenance teams on walkdowns, measurements, commissioning, tuning, and troubleshooting. Use mass and heat balances, fan and duct assessments, and false air audits to separate process, control, instrumentation, and model limits. Stay through stabilization, verify results in the field, and close corrective actions after handover. Plant leadership: Lead and coach Production, Quality, and Plant Managers through agreed deployment plans. Secure owners, resources, and deadlines, resolve competing priorities, and escalate unresolved commitments to the SmartOps program lead. Plant management keeps daily operating and line management accountability. Governance and benefits: Run daily follow-up during commissioning and regular reviews after handover. Track adoption, closed-loop (autopilot) utilization, overrides, and production and quality stability. With plant teams and Finance, verify gains in specific heat and power, alternative fuel substitution, reagent use, and grinding media and refractory life, within emissions limits. Capability building: Train users from Plant Managers to control room operators, at the equipment and in the control room, and check that they can apply what they learned. Leave local owners, operating guidance, and support routines in place. As a PI and Seeq power user, build use cases and baselines that plant engineers can reuse. Deployment template: Package each deployment for the next plant (model specification, readiness checklist, acceptance criteria, training material) and turn recurring diagnostics into online tools. Safety Safety outcomes: With Production, Quality, and Health and Safety teams, implement changes that reduce hazardous manual work and exposure to hot material, dust, and moving equipment, such as remote inspection, automated sampling, and steadier operation that cuts blockages and hot meal handling. Agree safety objectives before each trial and verify results with site Health and Safety, such as interventions avoided and exposure time reduced. Operating envelope: Define and validate operating constraints, equipment protection limits, and environmental boundaries for every model and control. Keep required interlocks and independent protections, set up operator override and safe fallback, and apply Management of Change (MoC) with site approval before release. Field safety: Follow local safety rules, CEMEX standards, and site procedures. Complete required training, wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), and confirm risk assessments, permits, energy isolation, and competence before field tasks. Take part in safety committees and in near-miss and incident investigations linked to SmartOps work. New technology pilots Technology pilots: When assigned, evaluate sensing, machine vision, robotics, or process technologies. Run plant trials against an agreed baseline, test vendor claims under operating conditions, and recommend scale-up or discontinuation from the measured results. Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Chemical, Process, Mechanical, Industrial, or Control and Automation Engineering, or in Chemistry. An advanced degree is a plus. Experience: 8+ years in cement plant operations with hands-on work in both production and quality, including 3+ years accountable for kiln, raw mill, or cement mill production or quality results as Superintendent, Quality Manager, Process Manager, or above. Plant Production Manager experience is strongly preferred. Languages and travel: Fluent English and Spanish, spoken and written. Valid passport and US business visa, or able to obtain them before start. Knowledge Skills And Abilities Production and quality credibility: Cement manufacturing experience across quality, operations, and maintenance, with the credibility to coach and challenge Production, Quality, and Plant Managers without line authority. Process diagnostics: Field process measurement, mass and heat balances, fan and false air assessments, and raw mix and clinker chemistry (LSF, moduli, clinker mineralogy, free lime). Able to lead RCA and turn findings into corrective actions. Models and APC: Plant-side owner of at least one Advanced Process Control (APC) or AI optimizer deployment on a kiln, mill, or raw mix: set its constraints, ran acceptance trials, and tracked utilization. Daily user of a process historian (PI System preferred) and DCS. Seeq and Python are a plus. Instrumentation and control: Practical experience with cement plant instrumentation (gas analyzers, kiln pyrometers, weigh feeders, cross-belt analyzers, and pressure, flow, and temperature transmitters), PID loop tuning, and minimum automation standards. Working conditions and physical requirements Working conditions Approximately 50% travel, mainly to US cement plants, for implementation, audits, trials, and follow-up. Assignments include sustained periods on site during commissioning and stabilization, with scheduled startup or shift support when required. When not traveling, works from the Monterrey offices supporting plants remotely. Exposure to heat, cold, noise, dust, and outdoor conditions during field work, with site controls and required PPE. Tobacco-free environment. Physical requirements Walks plant areas and climbs stairs across multi-story structures, such as preheater towers, while carrying portable instruments; also sits for office and remote work. Medium work, as defined in the ADA worksheet below. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear in order to communicate with employees/visitors as well as function safely around heavy rolling equipment. Must be capable of working at heights and in confined spaces. Must pass physical screening, hearing test, and drug/alcohol screen. Title: Private Capital Data Operations & AI Innovation Analyst
Description: Your Team Responsibilities Make an Impact at the Intersection of Financial Data, Technology & InnovationAbout the Team & Opportunity Are you passionate about financial data, energized by solving complex challenges, and excited about how AI is transforming the way we work? Join MSCI's Private Capital Solutions (PCS) team, where you'll play a key role in delivering the high-quality financial data that powers critical investment decisions for clients across the private capital industry. Our team sits at the intersection of financial expertise, cutting-edge technology, and client experience . We transform complex financial information into accurate, reliable, and actionable data, leveraging advanced technology, AI-powered tools, and strong analytical expertise to deliver exceptional results. In this role, you'll do more than oversee operations. You'll have the opportunity to lead improvements, influence how we work, solve meaningful client challenges, and help shape the future of AI-enabled financial data operations at MSCI. You'll collaborate with talented professionals across Data Operations, Product, Engineering, and Client Service, bringing together different perspectives to continuously improve our processes, strengthen data quality, and deliver an outstanding client experience. If you enjoy combining analytical thinking, technology, leadership, and continuous improvement, this is an opportunity to make a real impact. https://careers.msci.com/life-at-msci Your Key Responsibilities What You'll Do Drive Operational Excellence & Client Impact Take ownership of critical financial data operations, ensuring our Private Capital Solutions clients receive accurate, timely, and high-quality data. Be the go-to expert for complex client data challenges, using your analytical skills and problem-solving mindset to deliver effective solutions. Monitor operational performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and help the team consistently exceed quality and service expectations. Shape the Future of AI-Powered Data Operations Work hands-on with AI-enabled financial data extraction and validation tools, combining technology with human expertise to deliver reliable results. Help define what great data quality looks like by establishing quality benchmarks, strengthening validation frameworks, and ensuring transparency and auditability. Investigate complex data exceptions, uncover root causes, and develop sustainable solutions that improve accuracy and reduce recurring issues. Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, streamline workflows, and unlock new efficiencies through technology and innovation. Collaborate, Influence & Innovate Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Operations, and Client Service teams to solve challenges and improve the end-to-end client data experience. Turn operational insights and client feedback into meaningful recommendations that influence technology enhancements, workflows, and service improvements. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen data quality, operational controls, scalability, and overall team performance. Play an active role in evolving our financial data processes as new technologies and business needs emerge. Lead, Develop & Inspire Others Act as a trusted subject matter expert in private capital financial data, operational workflows, and AI-assisted data validation. Mentor and support Analysts and Associates, sharing your expertise, strengthening technical capabilities, and helping others grow. Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning. Use performance insights, KPIs, and operational analytics to identify trends, communicate results, and help drive informed decisions. Why This Role Matters Financial data is at the heart of the decisions our clients make every day. Your work will directly contribute to the accuracy, reliability, and scalability of the data services they depend on. This is an opportunity to combine your financial and analytical expertise with emerging AI technologies, collaborate with teams across MSCI, and help build smarter, more efficient ways of working. If you're someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving challenging problems, developing others, and turning ideas into meaningful improvements, we'd love to hear from you. Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel What You'll Bring to the Team We're looking for a curious, analytical, and solutions-oriented professional who thrives on solving complex challenges, embraces new technologies, and is passionate about making financial data smarter, more accurate, and more impactful. You'll be successful in this role if you bring a combination of financial expertise, technological curiosity, strong problem solving skills and a collaborative mindset. A strong foundation in finance and data: A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Data Science, or a related field. At least 3-5 years of relevant experience in financial data operations, data management, client data services, or a similar financial services environment. A passion for AI and emerging technologies: Hands-on experience using AI-powered data extraction and validation tools, with the analytical judgment to challenge outputs, identify inconsistencies, and ensure data accuracy and reliability. A natural problem-solving mindset: You enjoy getting to the root of complex issues, navigating ambiguity, and turning operational challenges into opportunities for smarter, more efficient ways of working. The ability to connect people, processes, and technology: Experience driving cross-functional initiatives and building strong relationships with Technology, Product, Operations, and client-facing teams to deliver meaningful improvements. The confidence to communicate and influence: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial data concepts, share insights, and engage stakeholders across different levels and functions. An uncompromising commitment to quality: A sharp eye for detail and a disciplined approach to data integrity, quality assurance, operational controls, and auditability, including within AI-assisted workflows. An understanding of private markets: Knowledge of private capital data, fund administration, investment operations, or related financial datasets, and an interest in how high-quality data supports investment decisions. A technology-driven approach to efficiency: Experience working with financial data pipelines, workflow automation or orchestration tools, and cloud-based data environments, with an eagerness to explore better ways of working. A collaborative leadership style: Experience mentoring or guiding junior colleagues, sharing knowledge, encouraging continuous learning, and helping build a high-performing team. What Will Make You Stand Out Beyond your technical experience, we value individuals who bring curiosity, initiative, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset . You're someone who doesn't just identify problems, you take ownership of solving them. You're excited about the potential of AI, comfortable challenging existing processes, and motivated by opportunities to make a tangible impact. If you're ready to combine your financial expertise with innovation, collaboration, and meaningful problem-solving, we'd love to hear from you! Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces. A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results. A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients. Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development. MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Title: Senior Data Analyst - Remote - Latin America
Description: About the role We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead the design and delivery of enterprise analytics. Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment. Kake is a remote-first company with a global community, fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career - we’re the destination. The icing on the Kake: 💰 Competitive Pay in USD: Work globally, get paid globally. 🌎 Fully Remote: Simply put, we trust you. 💜 Better Me Fund: We invest in your personal growth and passions. 🎂 Compassion is Badass: Join a community that invests in social good.

Title: Analista de Administración de Riesgos
Description: Descripción de la empresa GO Credit es una empresa financiera líder 100 % mexicana, creada para ofrecer préstamos con descuento vía nómina a trabajadoras y trabajadores de gobierno, educación y salud que no tienen acceso formal al sistema financiero. Desde 2011, el objetivo ha sido facilitar soluciones de financiación y consumo de forma rápida, sencilla y cercana. La empresa cuenta con una estructura sólida, presencia en las principales ciudades del norte de México y más de 100 personas colaboradoras. Su misión es brindar un servicio de alta calidad que fortalezca las finanzas de sus clientes, y su visión es situarse entre las cinco empresas líderes de nicho en México, apoyándose en pilares como mejor precio, producto y servicio. GO Credit se guía por valores como servicio, respeto, honestidad, integridad y competitividad. Descripción del puesto Como Analista de Administración de Riesgos en GO Credit, te encargarás de analizar, evaluar y controlar los riesgos asociados a los productos de crédito personal de la empresa. En el día a día, revisarás carteras de clientes, modelos de scoring y políticas de riesgo, proponiendo ajustes para mejorar la calidad del crédito y reducir la morosidad. Colaborarás con áreas como finanzas, operaciones y tecnología para implementar procesos y herramientas de gestión de riesgos, así como para dar seguimiento a indicadores clave. También participarás en la elaboración de informes, en la documentación de procesos y en la formación interna sobre políticas de riesgo. Este es un puesto de jornada completa, presencial, ubicado en Monterrey, NLE, y puede ofrecerse como contrato temporal según las necesidades de la empresa. Requisitos Aptitudes analíticas sólidas para interpretar datos, elaborar modelos de riesgo y tomar decisiones basadas en indicadores cuantitativos y cualitativos. Aptitudes de comunicación efectiva, tanto escrita como oral, para coordinarte con diferentes equipos y presentar informes claros a personas clave de la empresa. Conocimientos en finanzas, especialmente en créditos personales, gestión de cartera y conceptos básicos de riesgo financiero. Experiencia en gestión de programas y proyectos (program management), incluyendo planificación, seguimiento de hitos y coordinación de iniciativas de mejora de procesos. Capacidad para impartir formación interna y apoyar en la capacitación del personal sobre políticas, procedimientos y herramientas de administración de riesgos. Valorable formación universitaria en Economía, Finanzas, Administración, Matemáticas, Ingeniería o similar, así como manejo avanzado de Excel, herramientas de análisis de datos y conocimientos básicos de normativa financiera. Capacidad para trabajar en equipo, orientación al detalle, alto sentido de responsabilidad y adaptación a entornos cambiantes dentro del sector financiero, conocimienro en SQL ( indispensable).

Diseñar estrategias de segmentación de clientes y campañas comerciales para maximizar los ingresos, la interacción con los clientes y su valor a largo plazo. Aprovechar los modelos de segmentación de clientes para desarrollar estrategias diferenciadas dirigidas a: Clientes nuevos. Clientes frecuentes. Clientes de alto valor ( Power Users ). Encabezar la implementación de capacidades comerciales y mejores prácticas en los distintos mercados. Optimizar la administración y productividad de los activos comerciales en toda la región, liderando su gobernanza y optimización. Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos y transformando hallazgos analíticos en acciones concretas de negocio. Sólidas habilidades de gestión de grupos de interés ( stakeholder management ) y comunicación ejecutiva. Title: AI Engineer Lead | Tech Lead
Description: Tech Lead / AI Engineering Lead Modalidad: Presencial Jornada: Tiempo completo Nivel: Senior / Lead Misión Liderar técnicamente el diseño, construcción y evolución de soluciones de rocket code, asegurando que las necesidades del cliente y del negocio se conviertan en soluciones claras, viables, escalables y correctamente ejecutadas . El Tech Lead / AI Engineering Lead será referente técnico para equipos, clientes y stakeholders. Tendrá especial profundidad en Java, Angular, Oracle y WebLogic , pero deberá contar con criterio suficiente para liderar proyectos con diferentes arquitecturas, stacks e iniciativas de Inteligencia Artificial. Su responsabilidad irá más allá de definir arquitectura o revisar código: deberá entender la necesidad real detrás de un requerimiento, cuestionarlo cuando sea necesario, transformarlo en una solución técnica concreta y comunicarla con claridad a perfiles técnicos y de negocio . Objetivos principales Liderar técnicamente proyectos y establecer dirección sobre arquitectura, integraciones y criterios de implementación. Traducir necesidades funcionales, técnicas y de negocio en soluciones ejecutables. Asegurar estándares de desarrollo, seguridad, pruebas y mantenibilidad. Conectar stakeholders y tecnología, explicando decisiones, riesgos y alternativas. Guiar a los equipos promoviendo autonomía y consistencia técnica. Identificar oportunidades reales de AI y resolver problemas técnicos complejos cuando el contexto lo requiera. Responsabilidades principales Liderar técnicamente proyectos desde discovery hasta implementación. Participar en levantamiento y análisis de requerimientos con clientes y equipos internos. Traducir necesidades de negocio a requerimientos técnicos claros. Definir arquitectura, componentes, integraciones, flujos y decisiones de diseño. Identificar riesgos, dependencias, restricciones y deuda técnica. Presentar alternativas y explicar sus trade-offs. Estimar complejidad y dividir soluciones en componentes implementables. Guiar desarrolladores, realizar code reviews y validar estándares técnicos. Participar hands-on ante bloqueos complejos, PoCs, debugging o componentes críticos. Coordinar integraciones entre aplicaciones, APIs, bases de datos y servicios. Trabajar con Product Owners y Delivery Managers para alinear necesidad, viabilidad y ejecución. Mantener comunicación formal con stakeholders sobre decisiones, riesgos y avances técnicos. Presentar y defender propuestas técnicas frente a clientes. Promover seguridad, testing, observabilidad y documentación. Participar en troubleshooting e incidentes productivos. Evaluar y aplicar AI dentro del SDLC. Diseñar o acompañar soluciones con LLMs, RAG, agentes y automatización cuando generen valor. Perfil ideal Buscamos una persona con profundidad técnica, liderazgo y capacidad consultiva . Debe poder entrar a una conversación donde el cliente aún no expresa claramente su necesidad, realizar las preguntas correctas, comprender el contexto, identificar restricciones y regresar con una propuesta técnica clara y defendible. Debe adaptar su comunicación al interlocutor sin perder precisión técnica. La comunicación es central en esta posición. Debe expresarse de forma estructurada, formal y profesional; comunicar riesgos oportunamente y explicar decisiones sin generar fricción innecesaria. La empatía también será fundamental. No buscamos a quien únicamente diga “esto no se puede hacer” , sino a quien pueda explicar por qué, identificar qué sí es posible y proponer una alternativa. El rol deberá conservar suficiente capacidad hands-on para revisar código, validar implementaciones, construir pruebas de concepto y participar directamente cuando la complejidad técnica lo requiera. RequisitosFormación Ingeniería en Sistemas, Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería de Software, Tecnologías de la Información o formación equivalente respaldada por experiencia sólida. Experiencia 7+ años de experiencia en desarrollo de software, ingeniería o arquitectura. Experiencia como Tech Lead, Lead Engineer, Software Architect, Engineering Lead o equivalente. Experiencia liderando proyectos desde discovery y diseño hasta implementación. Experiencia sólida con Java, Java EE/Jakarta EE y Spring . Experiencia desarrollando o liderando soluciones con Angular . Experiencia productiva con Oracle y PL/SQL . Experiencia desplegando y manteniendo aplicaciones en Oracle WebLogic . Experiencia diseñando e integrando APIs y servicios. Experiencia realizando code reviews y guiando desarrolladores. Experiencia trabajando directamente con clientes y stakeholders. Capacidad para presentar y defender propuestas técnicas. Experiencia resolviendo problemas técnicos complejos. Conocimientos técnicosJava & Backend Java 17/21, Java EE/Jakarta EE, Spring Boot, JPA/Hibernate, microservicios, Clean Code, SOLID y Design Patterns. Frontend Angular, TypeScript, componentes, services, routing, forms, integración con APIs, HTML, CSS/SASS y Angular Material. Oracle y WebLogic Oracle Database, PL/SQL, procedures, query optimization, JDBC/JPA, WebLogic Domains, Clusters, EAR/WAR, Data Sources, deployment y troubleshooting. APIs y arquitectura REST, SOAP, OpenAPI, OAuth2, JWT, API Security, sistemas distribuidos, microservicios, Cloud, contenedores, CI/CD, seguridad, observabilidad, resiliencia y modernización legacy. No deberá ser especialista absoluto en cada tecnología, pero sí tener criterio para entenderla, cuestionarla y coordinar a los especialistas adecuados . Inteligencia Artificial AI deberá ser una capacidad técnica real del rol y no únicamente una herramienta de productividad. Se espera conocimiento o experiencia en: APIs de modelos de lenguaje y LLMs. Prompt Engineering, Structured Outputs y Tool / Function Calling. RAG, embeddings y Vector Databases. AI Agents y Agentic Workflows. Integración de AI con aplicaciones empresariales. Evaluación, guardrails y seguridad. Debe poder determinar cuándo AI genera valor y cuándo una solución tradicional es más adecuada . También deberá aprovechar AI para análisis de código, testing, debugging, documentación y prototipado. Liderazgo y stakeholders Esperamos que pueda: Establecer dirección técnica sin convertirse en cuello de botella. Delegar y desarrollar criterio técnico en otros ingenieros. Dar feedback claro y accionable. Cuestionar requerimientos cuando exista una alternativa mejor. Mantener ownership sobre la solución de principio a fin. Escuchar antes de proponer. Traducir negocio a tecnología y tecnología a impacto de negocio. Comunicar riesgos antes de que se conviertan en problemas. Presentar alternativas con ventajas, riesgos y trade-offs. Gestionar desacuerdos técnicos profesionalmente. Construir confianza mediante claridad, seguimiento y consistencia. La posición implica liderazgo técnico , aunque no necesariamente people management directo. Conocimientos deseables GCP, AWS o Azure. Docker y Kubernetes. Terraform y CI/CD avanzado. Apigee o API Management. Kafka y arquitecturas event-driven. Observabilidad y SRE. Modernización de aplicaciones legacy. Sector asegurador, banca o industrias reguladas. Preventa técnica y discovery con clientes. PoCs y arquitecturas empresariales de GenAI. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot o equivalentes. Competencias Liderazgo técnico, pensamiento crítico, comunicación ejecutiva y técnica, empatía, escucha activa, capacidad consultiva, resolución de problemas, ownership, negociación, orientación al cliente, adaptabilidad, manejo de ambigüedad y orientación a resultados. Indicadores de éxito Los requerimientos ambiguos se convierten en soluciones ejecutables. Los equipos cuentan con dirección técnica clara. Los riesgos se identifican antes de impactar el delivery. Existe alineación entre negocio, arquitectura e implementación. Los stakeholders comprenden las decisiones y mantienen confianza. Las implementaciones mantienen calidad, seguridad y mantenibilidad. Las iniciativas de AI responden a necesidades reales. Puede incorporarse a proyectos con diferentes tecnologías y generar claridad rápidamente. Lo que valoramos especialmente en rocket code En rocket code no esperamos que un Tech Lead sea simplemente la persona que más sabe de una tecnología . Buscamos a alguien capaz de generar claridad cuando un problema todavía no está bien definido: escuchar al cliente, entender qué necesita realmente, identificar restricciones y convertir la conversación en una solución que el equipo pueda construir. Valoramos una combinación sólida de profundidad técnica, liderazgo, empatía y comunicación . Java, Angular, Oracle y WebLogic serán fortalezas especialmente relevantes, pero no buscamos un perfil limitado por ese stack. Necesitamos un líder capaz de incorporarse a distintos proyectos, aprender rápidamente el contexto, apoyarse en especialistas y mantener ownership sobre la coherencia técnica de la solución. La Inteligencia Artificial deberá ser parte natural de esa capacidad, tanto para construir nuevas soluciones como para mejorar la velocidad y calidad del trabajo. El objetivo final es que, frente a un problema complejo, el cliente y el equipo sepan que existe una persona capaz de entenderlo, explicarlo y conducir técnicamente su solución .

Title: Gerente de Compras, Innovación e Inteligencia Artificial
Description: En Grupo Salinas buscamos agentes de cambio con mentalidad positiva e innovadora, dispuestas a trabajar en equipo para la solución de problemas en las diversas industrias en las que tenemos presencia a nivel nacional e internacional. Gerente de Compras, Innovación e Inteligencia Artificial Objetivo del puesto: Convertir el potencial de la inteligencia artificial y la automatización en mejoras medibles y sostenibles en los procesos de compras. El puesto existe para cerrar la brecha entre lo que la tecnología ya permite y lo que el área hace hoy: detectar dónde está el valor, traducir el proceso de negocio a un lenguaje que los sistemas puedan ejecutar, y llevar las iniciativas de la idea al piloto y del piloto a la operación con beneficio demostrable en datos. Es un rol híbrido de consultoría de negocio e innovación, con autonomía para definir cambios y mejoras de proceso con base en mejores prácticas y con criterio suficiente de datos y de sistemas para que sus recomendaciones sean implementables. Requisitos Lic. Mercadotecnia, administración de empresas o áreas afines. Titulado o en proceso de titulación comprobable (indispensable) Ingles intermedio Experiencia Con experiencia de al menos de 2 años como consultor de compras Experiencia en transformación del abastecimiento estratégico Automatización del proceso de compras, por medio de la IA. Funciones Realizar levantamientos rápidos de los procesos de compras entrevistas, observación, talleres, revisión documental y análisis de datos y mapear el proceso actual con sus variantes, volúmenes, tiempos, controles y excepciones. Traducir el proceso a una especificación ejecutable por los sistemas: reglas de negocio explícitas, árboles de decisión, criterios de validación, manejo de excepciones y datos requeridos; y redactar los requerimientos funcionales y criterios de aceptación para TI o el proveedor. Analizar el gasto y las transacciones categorías, proveedores, volúmenes, ciclos y desviaciones para dimensionar cada oportunidad, construir el caso de negocio y definir el criterio de priorización del portafolio. Mantener actualizado el mapa de tecnologías de IA y automatización relevantes para compras qué existe, qué madurez tiene y qué problema resuelve y validar su factibilidad mediante prototipos y pruebas de concepto propias. Emitir la recomendación de solución (comprar, configurar, construir o no hacer), establecer los estándares de documentación de procesos y mejores prácticas del área, y presentar hallazgos y avances con sustento a la Dirección y a los dueños de proceso. Ofrecemos Sueldo bruto mensual $50,000.00 Prestaciones: Vacaciones iniciando con 12 días al año, Prima vacacional del 25% anual, Aguinaldo de 15 días al año, el cual aumenta de acuerdo con tu antigüedad. Condiciones Laborales: Horario de 8 horas diarias de lunes a viernes. Disponibilidad de horario. Seguro de vida. Beneficios del puesto: Plan de Entrenamiento acorde al puesto, así como para el desarrollo de habilidades personales. Beneficios financieros: Adelanto de nómina. Acceso a tarjeta de crédito. Descuentos desde el 10% en productos dentro de tiendas Elektra y Salinas & Rocha, en compras de contado desde el primer día, y a crédito a partir de los 9 meses de antigüedad. Crédito Personal con tasa preferencial a partir de los 2 años. Cambio de divisas. Cuentas de inversión. Caja de ahorro. Servicios: Acceso al Nutriólogo, Psicólogo, Odontólogo, Biblioteca, concursos y programas para mejorar tu salud, Consejos y acompañamiento en tus logros, nuevos integrantes en la familia y celebraciones importantes. Promociones y Convenios para ti y tu familia: Descuentos en gimnasios, cines, centros de entretenimiento, conciertos, restaurantes, tiendas departamentales, ópticas, laboratorios, clínicas, colegios, escuelas de idiomas, universidades, aerolíneas, viajes, agencias automotrices, guarderías. ¡Construye tu propia historia de éxito con nosotros!

Title: Supply Chain Management Expert
Description: Summary We are looking for a Supply Chain Management Expert responsible for ensuring product availability through effective supply planning, inventory management, purchase order follow-up, risk mitigation, and cross-functional coordination. This role is key to ensuring supply continuity, optimizing inventory, reducing operational risks, and contributing to service level, efficiency, and business profitability objectives. About The Role Major accountabilities: Translate demand and supply strategies into executable supply plans that ensure product availability while balancing service, inventory, cost, compliance, and operational efficiency. Develop, monitor, and continuously optimize supply plans across complex networks involving multiple products, sites, suppliers, markets, and regulatory requirements. Identify, assess, and mitigate supply risks, including shortages, excess inventory, obsolescence, slow-moving stock, and supply disruptions. Manage inventory performance and key supply chain KPIs, ensuring achievement of service, availability, inventory, and supply plan adherence targets. Collaborate cross-functionally with Demand Planning, Procurement, Manufacturing, Quality, Warehousing, Logistics, Finance, Regulatory Affairs, and external partners. Support S&OP and S&OE processes through data-driven analysis, scenario planning, risk assessments, and actionable recommendations. Utilize SAP S/4HANA and other ERP systems to manage material planning, inventory, procurement, order management, production, and master data activities. Leverage advanced analytics and digital tools, including Excel, Power BI, and data visualization platforms, to improve supply chain visibility, traceability, and decision-making. Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on inventory optimization, automation, process simplification, waste reduction, data quality enhancement, and operational excellence. Ensure compliance with applicable quality, regulatory, and operational standards while maintaining effective management of batch-controlled and expiry date-sensitive products. Essential Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field. Solid knowledge of end-to-end supply chain processes, supply planning, inventory management, S&OP, key performance indicators, regulatory compliance, and products managed by batch and expiration date. Strong experience working with ERP systems, preferably SAP S/4HANA, as well as advanced analytics and reporting tools such as Excel and Power BI. Proven analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with a continuous improvement mindset, strong adaptability to new technologies, and the ability to make data-driven decisions in complex and dynamic environments. Advanced English proficiency with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to effectively collaborate with global teams, suppliers, manufacturing sites, and international business partners. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Title: Director of Operations, Service Delivery
Description: About LawnStarter LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, spanning three brands: LawnStarter, Lawn Love, and Home Gnome. We've cleared $750M in bookings and turned a profit three years running. Founded in Austin in 2013, we're a team of about 180 that scales past 500 employees during peak season. The marketplace itself is easy to describe and hard to run well: a customer requests a service, we price the job and match it to an eligible Pro, the Pro claims and completes the work, and we process payment and take a commission. We're entering the most ambitious stretch in the company's history as we build new verticals, new software products, and the groundwork to become a multi-billion-dollar company. One of our company values is AI or Extinction: every task, AI-first. No exceptions, no excuses. Top 1% or we're already a fossil. This role is hired against that bar. The Role This is a biz ops generalist role, built for someone who wants to work across many parts of the business instead of owning one narrow lane. You'll start as an individual contributor with no direct reports, in a new seat reporting directly to the COO. Your first owned area will be building Service Delivery into a working operational function. This will entail adding structure, visibility and process to the way we ensure as many customer jobs as possible are completed successfully and on time by LawnStarter Pros, in lawn care and other services we offer now and over time. New projects will show up unscoped over time. That's by design. As LawnStarter enters new verticals and grows toward a multi-billion-dollar future, big problems will keep surfacing with no obvious owner, and you'll be one of the people the COO trusts to run them down. What Makes This Role Different You work on some of the biggest company-wide projects, cutting across teams and functional areas You'll be a top builder in Brain, LawnStarter's internal AI toolkit built on Claude Code that already powers everything we do across the company: metric queries, document drafting, bug triage, and more. We expect you to approach your work in an AI-first fashion, leveraging Brain to build new systems and processes that will push the limits of how fast AI can accelerate business results. Every project you run is built AI-first: the analysis, the tooling, the process automation, the monitoring. You build it yourself instead of waiting on an analyst or engineer You own outcomes end to end, from recommendation through execution. Strategy without follow-through doesn't count here What You'll Own Service Delivery, from the ground up. Despite LawnStarter's considerable scale and reach, Service Delivery doesn't exist yet as a dedicated function. You'll help define the standards we should meet for job completion rates and speed, measure whether we hit them, and design processes, incentives and real-time interventions that get tested with Pros and customers in the field to lift performance. Scope covers every vertical and every delivery model, from today's 1099 Pros to potential W-2 crews under future evaluation Raising customer & Pro retention rates. When we deliver service with excellence, Pros and customers alike stay with us longer. Working tightly with peers across Product, Data and Support, you'll identify new opportunities for us to boost retention and LTV and play a key role in driving resulting initiatives cross-functionally Whatever comes next. New projects will land on your plate as the company grows into new verticals and builds new software products. You'll take them from "we should look into this" to building and then running systems with structure, KPIs and owners Problems to Solve Build a Service Delivery function that doesn't exist yet. Right now, no one formally owns whether LawnStarter delivers the service it promises. You'll define the standard for what a Pro should deliver, then build the agents and pipelines that measure adherence to it and run the tests that change behaviors and outcomes in the field. Move metrics. Leverage systems thinking and AI expertise to drive business results that sit across various functional teams. That means untangling handoffs where several teams touch a problem or goal and no one team owns the outcome. Take unscoped problems from ideas to fully-running and automated systems. Some of the most important work here hasn't been named yet. At some point, someone will raise a fuzzy, unframed problem and say it needs attention. Your job is to take that starting point and build whatever tooling or process it needs, at record speed, and hand back something that runs, with a clear owner and quantitative targets attached. What Success Looks Like (Year 1) Service Delivery is a working function with a defined (and elevated) service standard, a way to measure adherence to it, clear SOPs, and an intervention and incentive playbook that's been tested and proven to lift results At least one project nobody had scoped a year earlier has gone from "we should look into this" to a heavily-automated, running system with a named owner and tracked KPIs Tools you built with AI are in daily use by people other than you, and the way you work has raised the bar for how the company uses AI The COO can hand you a gray-area problem with no playbook and trust that what comes back is data, a recommendation, and a plan to execute it Requirements Who You Are An elite AI builder. You think in terms of agentic systems. Building agents, evals, context engineering, and thinking in guardrails are core to who you are. You keep up with the frontier and put new capabilities to work within days, not quarters. You'd be in the top few percent of AI users at any company you've worked at. Someone who treats AI as an occasional assistant, or needs an engineer to build tooling for them, isn't the right fit here. A zero-to-one operator. You've taken ambiguous, cross-team operating problems from zero to running systems as an individual contributor, with no team to hand the work to. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your experience stops at executing a scope someone else already defined. Marketplace-tested. You've operated inside a marketplace or another multi-sided business and felt firsthand what it takes to balance the needs of different stakeholders on the supply and demand sides. A background built entirely on single-sided businesses, with one stakeholder type to satisfy, won't translate here. A finisher. Executing what you recommend matters as much to you as the recommendation itself. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you treat strategy as your job and execution as someone else's. A partner who can help drive strategy collaboratively. You work well with people who don't report to you and are a savvy cross-departmental collaborator on priorities and sequencing. If you need formal authority to effect change, this role isn't for you. Data-driven by reflex. You'd rather build the query or the dashboard than argue from a hunch. This is unlikely to be a good fit if, when ambiguity hits, your first move is to guess and move on instead of digging for the number. At home in unresolved ambiguity. Scope shifts as priorities do, and problems arrive unframed more often than not. That's the norm here, not an exception. Degree in analytics, business or related field, with 7+ years of experience in marketplace operations or equivalent roles. This Role Is NOT A people-management role. There's no team to build or manage, at least not to start A strategy-only seat. You'll execute what you recommend, not hand it off to someone else to run A fit for anyone who isn't already an elite AI builder. The AI bar on this team isn't aspirational; it's the baseline we hire against Benefits Compensation & Benefits Base salary: $120,000 to $135,000 Fully remote: This is deep-focus analytical work with US-facing partners. We hire the best analyst regardless of city and trust you to manage your environment and overlap hours Flexible PTO: Measured on outcomes, not hours logged VERY IMPORTANT REMINDER: Please upload your English resume. Applications without it will not be considered LawnStarter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. We comply with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment.

Title: Senior RevOps Engineer
Description: About Improvado Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance. We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution. About the role Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team. What you will do Salesforce and GTM stack Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing). Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals. Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires. Contract to cash Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent. Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat. Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports. Revenue analytics and data model Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs). Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing. Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks. Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner. AI and automation Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output. Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided. Ownership Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric. Requirements 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org. Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus. Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals. Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM. Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use. Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked. Nice to have Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification. ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool. Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
